subject: POC/Trial planning - RACI & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@mountainhealth.org>, Dr. Rahul Mehra <rahul.mehra@mountainhealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC/Trial planning - RACI & next steps

Hi Samantha / Rahul —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC trial so we can align on responsibilities and timeline: 

1) Success criteria (we discussed):
- Reduction in average inference latency for requests to clinical summarization endpoint to < 300ms (p99 target)
- Embedding similarity recall >= 92% on the provided benchmark set (we'll run a 1k query sample)
- No PHI leaves your VPC during trial (private deployment + KMS)

2) Evaluation plan:
- Redwood will provision a private trial environment (dedicated instance) and deploy model variant A (quantized) for initial test.
- We will run the benchmark suite and a traffic replay using anonymized logs.
- Deliverables: perf report, cost estimate, and hitlist of any functional gaps.

3) Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (next week): finalize SOW and sign A/NDA addendum (if needed)
- Week 1: infra provision + data onboarding (anonymized)
- Week 2: run benchmarks + initial tuning
- Week 3: customer validation and decision meeting

4) RACI (high level) — please confirm owners:
- Infra provisioning: Mountain Health infra team (you) — CC’ing Aditya for infra onboarding support
- App integration (calls to inference API): Rahul / App team
- Security & compliance signoff (VPC, KMS): Lena / Security + Procurement for contract terms
- Redwood responsibilities: Marissa (program lead), Lauren (solutions/eng), Aditya (infra onboarding)

Next steps: I attached a short SOW draft and a success criteria spreadsheet for you to review. Please confirm owners for the RACI items above and whether the proposed timeline looks good. Happy to sync for 30 min tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0199

From: Dr. Rahul Mehra <rahul.mehra@mountainhealth.org>

Cc: Lena Hart <lena.hart@mountainhealth.org>, procurement@mountainhealth.org
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC/Trial planning - RACI & next steps

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Infrastructure: Our infra team (I’m looping in our lead, Lena) will own provisioning the private VPC and peering. We will need the exact subnet & firewall requirements by EOD Friday to avoid delays.
- Security: Our security/compliance lead will validate that KMS integration and audit logging meet our policies; Lena is the right owner for this.
- Data: We will provide an anonymized 1-week log dump and a 1k query sample by Monday.
- Timeline: Week 1 looks tight for us given procurement approval — we likely need 10 business days for the procurement/contract signature unless Redwood can provide a shorter trial SOW (no commercial commitment) to start testing earlier.

Can Redwood provide a non-binding trial SOW (technical trial) so we can begin infra work while procurement processes the master agreement? If so, we can start onboarding sooner.

On infra owners: Rahul (app) and Lena (infra/security) — confirm.

Thanks,
Rahul
Director, Clinical Informatics
Mountain Health
